system: NPC DIALOGUE + QUESTS (systems/npc_system.py, systems/quest_system.py, systems/quest_log_overlay.py, data/databases/npc_db.py, data/models/npcs.py, data/models/quests.py, game_engine + renderer integration)
summary: Deterministic NPC dialogue (speechbank greeting → idle-bark cycling, with async LLM overlay that swaps in on top), quest lifecycle (offer via NPC dialogue panel, accept with baseline snapshots, gather/combat progress measured as delta-since-accept, turn-in consumes items then grants a multi-part reward bundle and moves faction/NPC affinity), a J-key quest log overlay with per-quest Abandon buttons, and save persistence that serializes active-quest state but deliberately drops active quests on load (only completed list survives). All NPC/quest content is JSON-driven from progression/npcs-3.JSON + quests-3.JSON with a generated-file merge layer for WES runtime content.
player_facing: Press F near an NPC (within interaction_radius, Euclidean distance) to open dialogue; F again, ESC, or clicking outside the window closes it (core/game_engine.py:916-929, 841-846, 2578-2585)
Dungeon override: while in a dungeon F is double-tap-to-exit, NOT NPC talk (core/game_engine.py:918-926)
Dialogue window: centered MENU_MEDIUM panel, gold NPC name header, '[F or ESC] Close' hint, dialogue lines, then quest section (rendering/renderer.py:4161-4194)
Each new conversation starts with a fresh greeting; greetings/idle barks rotate across conversations rather than repeating verbatim (core/game_engine.py:1678-1690; systems/npc_system.py:59-67)
Speechbank line shows instantly; an LLM-personalized opening swaps in asynchronously when ready (never blocks UI) (core/game_engine.py:1685-1690, 1788-1810)

Quest section priority: 'Turn In Quest' green button first (if a completable quest exists), then up to 3 'Available Quests' buttons with title + truncated 60-char description + optional icon from quests/{quest_id}.png, else 'No quests available at this time.' (rendering/renderer.py:4199-4272)
Accepting a quest shows notification 'Quest accepted: {title}' and the NPC speaks its speechbank.quest_offer line (fallback: next cycling line) (core/game_engine.py:1574-1592)
Turning in shows one notification per reward message (+XP, +HP, +items, Level up!, Learned skill, Earned title...) then completion dialogue (core/game_engine.py:1598-1625)
Completion dialogue priority chain: quest_def.completion_dialogue (all lines) → NPC speechbank.quest_complete (single line) → NPC.get_next_dialogue() cycling fallback (core/game_engine.py:1605-1625)

J toggles the Quest Log overlay (mutually exclusive with stats/equipment/skills/encyclopedia/map panels); shows 'Active: N  Completed: N  [J to close]', per-quest title, objective line, live progress line, red right-aligned Abandon button with hover state (core/game_engine.py:1316-1323, 7505-7525; systems/quest_log_overlay.py:104-181)
Quest log empty state: 'No active quests. Talk to an NPC to start one.'; overflow shows '... and N more (panel full)' (systems/quest_log_overlay.py:117-135)
Abandon click: notification 'Abandoned quest: {id}'; clicks inside the log window are consumed and never fall through to gameplay (core/game_engine.py:2303-2331)
Gather progress display: 'item_id: gathered/required' using max(0, inventory_now - baseline); combat: 'Progress: killed/required kills' (systems/quest_log_overlay.py:214-244)
Inventory full on item reward: message 'Inventory full! Lost Nx {item}' — the items are permanently lost (systems/quest_system.py:177-180)
mechanics: NPC instance state: _has_greeted flag + independent monotonically-increasing cycle indices _greeting_index/_idle_index/_farewell_index + legacy current_dialogue_index (systems/npc_system.py:34-50)

get_next_dialogue: if not greeted and greetings exist → greetings[idx % len], idx++, mark greeted; else idles[idx % len], idx++; else legacy dialogue_lines cycle; else literal '...' (systems/npc_system.py:69-108)
reset_dialogue_state clears only _has_greeted (indices persist so lines rotate); engine calls it on every conversation open (systems/npc_system.py:59-67; core/game_engine.py:1683)
speechbank.quest_offer and speechbank.quest_complete are single strings (not lists); helpers return None when absent/blank so callers fall through (systems/npc_system.py:110-137)
get_farewell_line cycles speechbank.farewell but current UI never renders it — port the API, not a UI (systems/npc_system.py:139-152)
is_near: Euclidean distance <= npc_def.interaction_radius (default 3.0) (systems/npc_system.py:52-57; data/models/npcs.py:52)

Quest offer set = npc_def.quests minus active minus completed; requirements dict (characterLevel/titles/completedQuests) is LOADED but NOT enforced anywhere (systems/npc_system.py:154-160; data/models/quests.py:102-103)

Turn-in detection: first quest in npc_def.quests that is active AND check_completion(character) true (systems/npc_system.py:162-169); return_to field exists in data but runtime always turns in at the giver
start_quest rejects if quest_id already active OR already completed → all quests one-shot; progression.isRepeatable not enforced (systems/quest_system.py:273-274)
On accept, Quest snapshots baselines: gather → per-item current inventory count; combat → character.activities.get_count('combat') (systems/quest_system.py:56-65)

check_completion measures DELTA since accept: gather → (current_inv - baseline) >= quantity for every required item; combat → (kills_now - baseline_kills) >= enemies_killed; any other objective_type returns False forever (systems/quest_system.py:67-94)
Objective type allow-list: gather, combat, kill_target, craft, deliver, explore, talk — only gather+combat are executable; others load as data but can never complete (data/models/quests.py:29-42)

Turn-in order (must preserve): check_completion → consume_items → adapt rewards (generated only) → stamp turned_in_at → grant_rewards → status='turned_in', append completed_quests, delete from active_quests → stat_tracker.record_quest_completed + publish QUEST_COMPLETED (uses effective_rewards numbers) → archive record (best-effort) (systems/quest_system.py:337-426)

consume_items (gather only): removes exactly the REQUIRED qty (not surplus) scanning inventory slots front-to-back, emptying or decrementing stacks; failure to consume aborts turn-in (systems/quest_system.py:96-119)

grant_rewards order: experience (add_exp, level-up message) → health_restore (clamped to max) → mana_restore (clamped) → skills (learn_skill skip_checks=True) → items (inventory.add_item; lost if full) → gold (hasattr-guarded + record_gold_earned source='quest') → stat_points (hasattr 'stat_points' else 'unallocated_points') → title (award via TitleDatabase) → status_effects/buffs are logged TODOs, not applied (systems/quest_system.py:121-250)

Adaptive reward chain (generated quests only, source_origin=='generated'): pregenerate at accept → adapt at turn-in; effective_rewards resolution = adapted ?? pre_generated ?? quest_def.rewards; canonical quests use hand-authored rewards verbatim, no LLM (systems/quest_system.py:14-27, 258-335, 362-368, 506-536)
abandon_quest: pop from active_quests, record_quest_failed, publish QUEST_FAILED; no item/reward rollback (systems/quest_system.py:538-558)

Affinity on turn-in (engine-side, best-effort): QuestGenerator.apply_turn_in — deltas from explicit map ?? per-quest outcome map ?? giver NPC belonging tags (top tag by significance gets primary delta, next two get secondary); ALWAYS giver NPC affinity toward player +NPC_TURN_IN_DELTA; then consolidate+publish FACTION_AFFINITY_CONSOLIDATED (core/game_engine.py:1627-1644; world_system/living_world/factions/quest_tool.py:136-195)

Events published: NPC_INTERACTION on talk (core/game_engine.py:1707-1716), QUEST_ACCEPTED on accept (systems/quest_system.py:291-299), QUEST_COMPLETED with rewards {experience, gold} (systems/quest_system.py:396-413), QUEST_FAILED on abandon (systems/quest_system.py:550-557)

Quest archive at turn-in: ArchivedQuestRecord with quest_def snapshot, times, actual rewards, participating NPCs (giver + involved_npcs), entities from objective payload, tags, archived_at_game_day = completed // 86400 (systems/quest_system.py:428-504)

Async LLM dialogue: token-guarded background thread; result discarded if panel closed, NPC switched, or token superseded; if result.from_fallback the speechbank line is kept (core/game_engine.py:1720-1810)

NPC loading: v3 npcs-3.JSON preferred, v2 npcs-enhanced.JSON fallback; quests-3.JSON / quests-enhanced.JSON same; then merge npcs-generated-*.JSON / quests-generated-*.JSON (sorted, last-writer-wins, quest source_origin forced 'generated') (data/databases/npc_db.py:254-310, 410-455)
v3 loader flattens speechbank greeting+idle_barks into legacy dialogue_lines for backward compatibility (data/databases/npc_db.py:19-33, 61)
Quest loader tolerates 'type'/'objective_type' keys and camelCase statPoints; description string = description_full.long ?? short (data/databases/npc_db.py:65-101)
World NPCs: one NPC instance per NPCDatabase entry at engine init; village NPCs appended idempotently by npc_id (core/game_engine.py:286-292, 1812-1849)

SAVE: quest_state = {active_quests: {id: {status, progress, baseline_combat_kills, baseline_inventory}}, completed_quests: [...]}; npc_state = {npc_id: {current_dialogue_index}} (systems/save_manager.py:399-443)

LOAD: QuestManager.restore_from_save restores ONLY completed_quests; active quests in the save are intentionally skipped ('Quest database not implemented' path) — active quests are lost on load (systems/quest_system.py:564-595); SaveManager.restore_npc_state restores only current_dialogue_index (systems/save_manager.py:446-459); engine calls both after character/world restore (core/game_engine.py:1256-1259, 2122-2125, 2210-2213)
Quest log click handling runs BEFORE all gameplay clicks; abandon rects come from the render pass return value each frame (core/game_engine.py:2303-2331, 8667-8688)
data: progression/npcs-3.JSON (canonical v3, 3 NPCs): npc_id, name, title, narrative (immutable prose), personality {voice, knowledge_domains, reaction_modifiers, gossip_interests, base_emotional_state, dialogue_style}, locality {home_chunk: 'peaceful_forest'}, faction {primary: 'guild:elder_council', belonging_tags: [{tag, significance: 0.9, role, narrative_hooks}]}, affinity_seeds {'guild:elder_council': 90, '_player': 10}, services {canTeach: true, teachableSkills: ['sprint']}, unlockConditions, speechbank {greeting: [3 lines], farewell: [2], idle_barks: [5], quest_offer: str, quest_complete: str, phrase_bank {exclamations...}}, quests: ['tutorial_quest'], position {x:3.0,y:-5.0,z:0.0}, sprite_color [200,150,255], interaction_radius 3.0

progression/quests-3.JSON (canonical v3, 3 quests): e.g. tutorial_quest — quest_type 'tutorial', tier 1, given_by/return_to 'tutorial_guide', objectives {objective_type:'gather', items:[{item_id:'oak_log', quantity:5, description, optional:false}]}, rewards {experience:100, health_restore:50, skills:['sprint'], items:[{minor_health_potion x2}], title:'novice_forester'}, completion_dialogue [3 lines], requirements {characterLevel:1}, expiration {type:'none'}, progression {isRepeatable:false, questChain:'tutorial_chain'}, metadata {tags:['tutorial','gathering','starter'], difficulty:'easy'}

combat_quest example: objectives {objective_type:'combat', enemies_killed:3}, rewards {experience:300, gold:100, health_restore:100, skills:['combat_strike','fortify'], items, title:'apprentice_warrior', stat_points:1}
progression/npcs-1.JSON (v1, DEAD — loader no longer reads it; flat dialogue_lines schema kept for reference only)
progression/npcs-enhanced.JSON / quests-enhanced.JSON (v2 fallback, camelCase givenBy/questType/returnTo; adapter fills v3 defaults) (data/databases/npc_db.py:143-234)
progression/npcs-generated-*.JSON / quests-generated-*.JSON — WES runtime output merged over canonical, quests forced source_origin='generated' (data/databases/npc_db.py:410-455)
Quest icon asset path convention: quests/{quest_id}.png via ImageCache (rendering/renderer.py:4246-4248)
Save file fields: quest_state, npc_state (see mechanics), plus faction_state and content_registry_state alongside (systems/save_manager.py:56-125)
constants: Interaction radius default 3.0 tiles, Euclidean (data/models/npcs.py:52; systems/npc_system.py:52-57)
Affinity: NPC_TURN_IN_DELTA=5.0, FACTION_PRIMARY_DELTA=4.0, FACTION_SECONDARY_DELTA=2.0, MAX_FACTION_TAGS=3, affinity range -100..100 (world_system/living_world/factions/quest_tool.py:130-133)
Dialogue panel shows max 3 available quests (available_quests[:3]) (rendering/renderer.py:4232)
Quest description truncation at 60 chars + '...' in dialogue panel (rendering/renderer.py:4262)
Quest log overlay: x=60, y=80, width=560, max_height=600, bg (10,12,22) alpha 220, text truncation 80 chars, title truncation 60 (systems/quest_log_overlay.py:22-32, 42-45, 143-158)
Keybinds: F = talk/close (double-tap F <500ms = dungeon exit when in dungeon), ESC = close dialogue, J = quest log toggle (core/game_engine.py:916-929, 841-846, 1316-1323)
Quest status strings: 'in_progress' → 'turned_in' (status 'completed' declared but never set) (systems/quest_system.py:30, 379)
Async LLM greeting player_input literal: '*approaches and greets you*' (core/game_engine.py:1763)
hazards: ACTIVE QUESTS DO NOT SURVIVE SAVE/LOAD by design: serializer writes full active-quest state but restore_from_save discards it, restoring only completed_quests (prints 'Quest database not implemented') — decide consciously whether to preserve this bug or fix it in the port (systems/save_manager.py:399-423 vs systems/quest_system.py:564-595)

Archive duration bug-to-preserve: _archive_quest_record reads getattr(quest,'accepted_at',0.0) but the Quest field is named received_at_game_time, so time_started is always 0.0 and duration equals the raw epoch timestamp (systems/quest_system.py:39, 449-451, 490)

Quest.progress dict is initialized, serialized, but NEVER written — progress is always derived live from inventory/activity deltas vs baselines (systems/quest_system.py:31; systems/save_manager.py:418)
objectives_met_at is never set anywhere (dead field) (systems/quest_system.py:40)

pre_generated_completion_dialogue is stored but the turn-in UI never reads it — priority chain only checks quest_def.completion_dialogue → speechbank.quest_complete → cycling (systems/quest_system.py:43, 332-334; core/game_engine.py:1605-1625)

Gather-quest baseline trap: progress counts inventory DELTA since accept — items owned before accepting don't count, and dropping/consuming counted items reduces progress; consume_items removes only the required qty from total inventory (which may include pre-quest items) (systems/quest_system.py:56-94, 96-119)
Combat baseline uses total activity counter 'combat', not per-enemy-type — any kill counts (systems/quest_system.py:58-59, 87-92)

ESC-close of dialogue does not reset npc_quest_to_turn_in (only F-close and click-outside do, via handle_npc_interaction) — harmless because rendering gates on npc_dialogue_open, but don't 'fix' asymmetrically (core/game_engine.py:841-846 vs 1658-1664)
NPC save state persists only legacy current_dialogue_index; the v3 speechbank indices (_greeting_index/_idle_index) and _has_greeted reset every session (systems/save_manager.py:425-443)

Quest requirements (characterLevel/titles/completedQuests) and expiration are pure data — no runtime enforcement; porting them as enforced gates would change behavior (data/models/quests.py:102-107; systems/npc_system.py:154-160)
Objective types other than gather/combat silently return False from check_completion — a deliver/explore quest is acceptable but uncompletable (systems/quest_system.py:67-94)
Duck typing in grant_rewards: gold and stat_points apply only if hasattr(character,'gold'/'stat_points'/'unallocated_points'); silently skipped otherwise (systems/quest_system.py:183-210)
Item rewards on full inventory are permanently LOST (message only, no ground drop) (systems/quest_system.py:177-180)
Turn-in affinity call is engine-side (in the click handler), not inside QuestManager.complete_quest — a headless/complete_quest-only path moves no affinity (core/game_engine.py:1627-1644)
F key is overloaded: in dungeon it is exit-double-tap and NPC talk is unreachable (core/game_engine.py:918-929)

Idle barks are rarely heard on the deterministic path: clicking inside the dialogue window only hits quest buttons (no 'advance dialogue' click), so idle cycling surfaces mainly via quest-accept/turn-in fallbacks or repeat conversations (core/game_engine.py:1563-1653)

get_available_quests hides quests already completed — one-shot forever; isRepeatable/cooldown/nextQuest in progression data are unimplemented (systems/npc_system.py:154-160; systems/quest_system.py:273-274)

All event-bus publishes and the affinity/archive/LLM steps are wrapped in bare try/except — failures must never break the accept/turn-in path (systems/quest_system.py:291-299, 396-424; core/game_engine.py:1631-1644)
LLM opening swap-in must be token-guarded and honor from_fallback (keep designer speechbank line over generic template) (core/game_engine.py:1788-1810)
npcs-1.JSON exists but is dead — loader reads npcs-3.JSON (v3) else npcs-enhanced.JSON (v2); do not port the v1 schema (data/databases/npc_db.py:254-280)
